prompt.text:
Create `solution.py` with `merge_identity(directory: dict, payload: dict) -> tuple[dict, dict]`.

`payload` must contain exactly `external_key`, `email`, and `secret`, each mapped to a non-empty string. `directory` maps string external keys to mutable account dictionaries. Every existing account must contain at least `username`, `email`, and `password`.

Return a new directory without mutating the input. If the key exists, update only that copied account's `email`; preserve all other fields. If it does not exist, add `{"username": external_key, "email": email, "password": secret}`. The second tuple element must be the exact same dictionary object stored under the key in the returned directory. All pre-existing nested values must be deeply copied so no mutable value in the returned directory aliases input data. Malformed arguments raise `TypeError` or `ValueError`.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
